# stripe_metronome_disable_custom_field_key_v1 (Action)

Invoke Metronome OpenAPI operation disableCustomFieldKey-v1 (POST /v1/customFields/removeKey). This action runs only when Terraform invokes it; it does not manage a durable object.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `path_params` (Map of String) Values for named path parameters, such as customer_id.
- `query_params` (Map of String) URL query parameters.
- `request` (Dynamic) HCL object using Metronome OpenAPI field names. Prefer this over request_json.
- `request_json` (String) JSON request body using the Metronome OpenAPI field names.
